origin.description: Assistant synthesis of the user-directed recovered vision; implementation and economic advantage require separate evidence.
Historical proposal supporting this meaning; not automatic authority.

payload.statement: An active architectural lens must select relevant observed units and contribute executable constraints or validators with explicit authority and assumptions. For handwritten code, accept different implementations that satisfy the predicates. Require exact output only when the lens explicitly owns deterministic generation. A prose description or an unregistered validator cannot establish conformance.
payload.title: Make architectural knowledge executable
